title: React — TaskFlow Lite Application

lessons.title: React Rendering Mental Model
lessons.why: Here’s the simple reason this matters: React calls components to calculate UI from current props and state. A render is a calculation, not a promise that the DOM is recreated from scratch. In this course, we connect it directly to the React version of TaskFlow Lite and the rules for state, rendering, effects, and component ownership, so you can see where the idea lives in a real project instead of memorizing a definition.
objectives: Explain React Rendering Mental Model in terms of inputs, owner, outputs, and failure modes.
Implement React Rendering Mental Model incrementally and predict observable evidence before execution.
Diagnose a controlled React Rendering Mental Model failure from evidence.
Apply React Rendering Mental Model to a new TaskFlow requirement without copying the reference implementation.
prerequisites: Complete the previous lesson in React — TaskFlow Lite Application or demonstrate equivalent skill.
Start from a healthy project/checkpoint.
mentalModel: Start with the plain-English idea. React calls components to calculate UI from current props and state. A render is a calculation, not a promise that the DOM is recreated from scratch.

Now place it in TaskFlow. This lesson belongs to the React version of TaskFlow Lite and the rules for state, rendering, effects, and component ownership. Ask four questions while you work: what enters this boundary, who owns the decision, what dependency does it use, and what evidence proves the result?

Keep the change small. Predict what you should see before you run anything, then compare the prediction with the real terminal, browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence. If they differ, debug the first mismatch instead of editing several places at random.

The goal is not to remember the exact snippet below. The goal is to be able to explain React Rendering Mental Model in your own words, rebuild the core behavior, and adapt it when the requirement changes.
